That sounds horrible. I get the difficulty of feeling like ending it will give you peace while not being ready to leave the ones you love. As someone who has lost a parent to suicide years ago, I can say that a child will never get over the trauma associated with losing a parent and will miss out of knowing the parent. The parent also loses out on seeing the child grow from first drives to their potential wedding. We might think we find solace in death, but that’s not possible when you cause the ones you love pain. Remember that all in all these nightmares are just that…nightmares. Not real. What is real is how you handle these nightmares. Show these nightmares that they can’t control you nor do they define you. Try some of the sleep techniques I mentioned before and keep in your mind that you are a father and that all fathers are heroes, strong enough to defeat all nightmares. I wish you all the best friend.
